tenderSchedule.title: Courier Services
tenderSchedule.description: Collecting Transporting and delivering of documents to various places in Karnataka and other Parts of India from KPCL Offices, Bengaluru
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL General Manager A and HR office Bengaluru

tenderAddress.blockNumber: No. 82, Shakthi Bhavan, Race Course Road

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders shall quote their rates inclusive of GST for each item of the price schedule of the tender
All terms and conditions are as per the tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Agency should have been in existence/operation for the last five years. Past experience of working with the govt. PSUs Autonomous bodies or Statutory bodies is preferred.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work order and completion certificate for the same

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The agency should have achieved average annual turnover of not less than Rs.30.00 Lakhs per annum during the last three financial years ending 31.3.2026

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The applicant shall be a single entity, registered as Company under the companies Act 2013 or Companies Act 1956 or any other previous Companies act in India, Partnership Firm registered under the Indian partnership Act ,1932, LLP registered under the limited liability Partnership Act,2008 and proprietorship should have been in existence in India for the last three years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of partnership Deed/Registration Certificate of the Company

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The agency must be registered in India within appropriate tax and other Administrative Authorities
The applicant should furnish an undertaking to the effect that the firm has not been black listed in India

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- An affidavit duly certified by Notary

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Organizations having office in Bengaluru shall be preferred

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of the address proof

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All documents required under PQR and other conditions of the tender
